sample_unit: LLM-generated responses (45 per model across 4 models)

links.outcome: LLM adaptation of medical guidance to literacy level, including interpretation of low literacy
links.effect: Literacy adaptation was consistently accurate across models, often near-zero error. However, models frequently misclassified low emotional and literacy levels as "normal" when interpreting outputs.
links.quote: Literacy adaptation was consistently accurate across models, often achieving near-zero error, indicating strong capability in adjusting explanatory complexity.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating LLM adaptation of tone to patient emotional state/sensitivity
Self-evaluation of generation-interpretation consistency in LLMs
Treating LLMs as assistive tools under human oversight rather than autonomous communicators

screen.reason: Evaluated the ability of LLMs to adapt communication to varying user literacy and emotional levels, testing prompt-level constraints and verbosity variations across models.
